description: Traces British alternative comedy, anti-comedy’s withheld payoff, cringe comedy’s failed social repair, and deadpan delivery as distinct challenges to performance expectations. Also examines Sianne Ngai’s zany aesthetic as a lens on performance labor and how audiences recognize deliberate disruptions rather than mere failed jokes.
